lines.en: label mollyspringcafegen:
scene mollyspringcafegen
I make my way to the cafe and walk through the doors with my mouth open in hope of being purified one final time before moving onto whichever definition of the afterlife is most accurate.
lines.zh: 我一路走到咖啡馆，张着嘴推门进去，盼着能最后一次被净化，然后再前往那个定义最准确的来世。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I just wind up looking like an idiot because Molly is actually working tonight and the cafe is decently busy.
lines.zh: 可惜，我只是显得像个傻子——因为今晚 Molly 真的在上班，而且店里还挺忙。

lines.en: It seems as if the city as a whole has been getting busier lately. Even the amount of men around appears to be increasing. But I imagine it's just due to the weather.
lines.zh: 最近整座城市似乎都变热闹了。连周围的男人数量看起来都在增加。不过我想这大概只是天气的缘故。

lines.en: There's not much of a reason to hide inside anymore now that the temperature has become somewhat bearable.
lines.zh: 既然气温已经勉强能忍受，也就没有多少理由继续躲在屋里了。

lines.en: It's only the pungent, sickening scent of cherry blossoms that compels me to stay inside at this point. I imagine that's just a {i}me{/i} problem, though.
lines.zh: 事到如今，唯一让我甘愿待在室内的，是那股刺鼻又令人作呕的樱花气味。不过我想，那大概只是{i}我{/i}自己的问题。

lines.en: scene black
Molly eventually finds the time to acknowledge my existence and bestows the rest of her responsibility onto another unlucky part-timer so she can come talk to me.
lines.zh: Molly 终于腾出时间来承认我的存在，把剩下的活儿丢给另一个倒霉的兼职生，好过来跟我说话。

lines.en: And surprisingly, she doesn't talk about anything annoying. She just asks me how I'm doing. But that is annoying in its own way.
lines.zh: 意外的是，她没聊什么烦人的话题。她只是问我最近怎么样。可这本身就已经够烦人的了。

lines.en: If she had only noticed my thirst for cleaning fluid when I first came in, she'd know the answer to that question.
lines.zh: 要是她在我进门时就看出我对清洁剂的渴望，她早该知道这个问题的答案了。

lines.en: I don't hold it against her, though. She has never been perfect and I can relate to that.
lines.zh: 不过我并不怪她。她从来都不完美，这一点我倒是感同身受。

lines.en: And if she continues to misunderstand the level in which I desire to be here, I think the two of us can stay friends.
lines.zh: 只要她继续误解我有多么想待在这里，我觉得我们俩还能继续做朋友。

lines.en: I leave the cafe. Molly does not.
lines.zh: 我离开了咖啡馆。Molly 没有。
